identity.formulaSource: frozen packet canonicalInci (treated as approved canonical full-INCI capture, ID-1)

identity.sourceGrading: CL-SRC/E1: product name 'Anti-Schuppen Shampoo Apple Fresh' = high; manufacturer source = moderate; retailer = low

cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2 (ether type); prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine #4; no prominent reinforcing anionic -> moderate. Sodium Xylenesulfonate #3 is a hydrotrope and Cocamide MEA #8 a foam booster (C3, neither route nor buffer). TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate #16 is a strong sulfonate but listed after Parfum, so C4 records it without counting it as a reinforcing route.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Section 5 anchors: one meaningful silicone/cationic-guar coacervate system - Dimethiconol #11, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #13, Dimethicone #14 - plus pearlizing Glycol Distearate #9 and late humectants Glycerin #21 / Panthenol #24. C2 not met: both silicones are after Parfum #6 ('early' = prominent, E3), so they are supporting routes only, and no prominent payload_lipid replaces them. Counter-signal toward high: two silicones + guar + pearlizer + humectants are the full C2 element set, missing only prominence.

excluded: Piroctone Olamine #10 (active, not a conditioning route)

depositionLoad.rationale: Silicone + cationic guar is a coacervate deposition system designed to leave silicone on hair; two silicones reinforce it.

persistence.rationale: Dimethiconol/dimethicone are persistent and can accumulate with repeated use, but no lipid or film-former converges.

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 ether-sulfate chassis with betaine buffer; late TEA-DDBS adds little.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: One meaningfully persistent silicone/guar system gives noticeable but bounded residue.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: no W-RICH (no prominent payload_lipid), no third converging family, effective C1 reset. W1 does not apply (no amodimethicone; post-round-2 'set without amodimethicone' - no presumption either way). Not low: a deliberate silicone+cationic deposition system makes a lightweight call an understatement (W2).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Silicone level unknown; deposition-optimized coacervate systems can be heavier than INCI order suggests.
weightPotential.rationale: 6.6 subjudgments moderate/moderate/moderate -> moderate; neighbors equally realistic is not the case - high is the more realistic neighbor (persistent silicones).

No separate sensitive/dry unit.
